applies_to: WaterFurnace geothermal heat pumps with Aurora controls and the IntelliZone2 zoning system (up to 6 zones), read through the Aurora BACnet controller.
summary: BACnet point list for a WaterFurnace heat pump running the IntelliZone2 zoning system. Besides the usual Aurora heat pump points (ABC inputs and outputs, ECM blower, VS pump, refrigerant and power data, humidity and DCV settings) it has a repeated block per zone 1-6 with zone temperature, BAS override, occupancy, setpoints, demand and damper limits. A large share of the rows are marked 'do not map to BAS'.
notes: Object names are the sheet's reference names (e.g. zone_temp_z1); the sheet also prints shorter display names (ZoneTempZ1).
Sheet tab is dated 6-16-21. Zone blocks repeat at 1100-1199 (zone 1) through 1600-1699 (zone 6); all six are printed and listed.
133 rows are marked 'do not map to BAS' in the source; they are listed for completeness as internal-use points.
Several options exist as both an AV and an MSV (zone size, zone mode, staging, occupancy); BV 1000 picks which set is used.
Multistate state texts are not printed in this sheet, and the mode table it refers to is not included.
The sheet does not state the BACnet transport or network settings.

integration.summary: Map the system points (emergency shutdown, alarm reset, mode, alarm value) once and then one zone block per active zone. Each zone takes a BAS occupancy signal and occupied heating/cooling setpoints, and reports its occupancy status and usable temperature. A zone temperature from the BAS needs BV 11x0 set to BAS and the value on AV 11x2.
integration.enable: BV 101 em_shutdown_c shuts the unit down and BV 105 load_shed_c sheds load from the network. Occupancy can come from the BAS per zone (BV 11x6, MV 11x0 or AV 11x9, depending on BV 1000) or from the internal schedule; BV 502 picks internal or external schedule.
integration.remote_sensors: For a BAS zone temperature, set BV 11x0 (temp_selector) to BAS and write AV 11x2 (zone_temp_ovrd). AV 504, AV 506 and AV 508 accept BAS space humidity, CO2 and VOC values, and AV 606 a BAS outdoor air temperature (BV 1017 picks the OAT source).
gotchas: Many points are flagged 'do not map to BAS'; leave them alone.
BV 318 gives the BAS write access to the ABC dip switch overrides; BV 398 takes it away.
Zone points repeat per zone: zone n uses instances 1n00-1n99 (zone 1 = 1100s).
